LESSON: GRAMMAR IN USE 9.3.1 WORD CLASSES: CONJUNCTIONS – BECAUSE, THAT, WHEN, IF, UNLESS, AND SINCE

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 9
Topic 9.3: Grammar in use 9.3.1 Word Classes: Conjunctions – because, that, when, if, unless, and since
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Grammar in use 9.3.1 Word Classes: Conjunctions – because, that, when, if, unless, and since, part of Strand 9 in Grade 8 ENGLISH.

Key inquiry question: Why should we join sentences correctly? 2. Why do we use conjunctions? 3. How can one join two or more sentences?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Grammar in use 9.3.1 Word Classes: Conjunctions – because, that, when, if, unless, and since together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Collaboration: It is enhanced as the learner recites poems with peers.

• Creativity and imagination: It is developed as the learner makes connections and creates posters on heroes or heroines.

Values:
Patriotism: It is promoted as the learner creates posters of African heroes and heroines and this makes them proud of their nation

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

Citizenship: Good governance is promoted as some African heroes’ and heroines’ stories address issues of governance

Link to other Learning Areas:

The concepts of creating posters is related to the strand of creating in Creative arts and sports.
